# Summary

The statute specifies that records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute. [[cite:obs-3bedb0e4eef65edb3afe24aa7705aec0bb68641c "Records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute."]]

The retention rule is that records must be kept according to the schedule defined within the statute itself. [[cite:obs-3bedb0e4eef65edb3afe24aa7705aec0bb68641c "Records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute."]]

The exact duration for which the records are kept is specified in the schedule of the statute, but the statute text does not provide a specific number of years. [[cite:obs-3bedb0e4eef65edb3afe24aa7705aec0bb68641c "Records of the society are retained for the period named in the schedule of this statute."]]
